news.headline: uniQure Charts Accelerated Path With AMT-130
news.summary: Recap piece confirming uniQure's alignment with FDA on using 3-year Phase I/II data as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA, with filing still slated for Q3 2026. No new data or dates beyond what was already disclosed at the Q2 earnings update.

news.headline: uniQure (QURE) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news.summary: Management detailed the accelerated-approval strategy for AMT-130 and reiterated that clinical updates for the epilepsy and Fabry disease pipeline programs are now expected in the first half of 2027.

news.headline: uniQure (QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target to $75 from $60 and maintained an Overweight rating, citing confidence in AMT-130's regulatory and commercial trajectory ahead of the September four-year data readout.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, $65 Price Target
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded QURE to Outperform with a $65 price target, pointing to an improved Huntington's therapy outlook following the FDA's accelerated-approval alignment.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure entered H2 2026 with over $810M in cash after a $259M capital raise, extending its runway into 2030, and reaffirmed plans to submit the AMT-130 BLA (US) and MAA (UK) in Q3 2026.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Reports 7.0% Passive Stake in uniQure
news.summary: JPMorgan disclosed beneficial ownership of roughly 4.87 million uniQure shares (7.0% of the class) in a passive-investment Schedule 13G filing.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year topline data (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: Four-year safety/efficacy readout on the first two treatment cohorts (12 high-dose + 12 low-dose patients, plus 3 additional high-dose patients at 3 years), benchmarked against a natural-history external control cohort; widely flagged by Stifel, Wells Fargo and Wolfe as the next major stock catalyst.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission to FDA (accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: uniQure and the FDA aligned that 3-year Phase I/II data can serve as the primary basis for a Biologics License Application under the accelerated approval pathway; company reaffirmed Q3 2026 filing timeline at Q2 earnings.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 UK MHRA Marketing Authorization Application
catalysts.detail: Following a successful pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans to submit an MAA to the UK's MHRA in parallel with the US BLA.

catalysts.label: Epilepsy and Fabry disease program updates
catalysts.detail: Management guided to clinical data/updates for the AMT-191 (Fabry) and epilepsy gene-therapy programs in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA action on AMT-130 accelerated approval
catalysts.detail: Contingent on BLA acceptance and priority review following the Q3 2026 filing; exact PDUFA date not yet set.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results and corporate update; exact date not yet announced by the company.

pulse: uniQure remains in a holding pattern of high anticipation heading into its September 2026 AMT-130 four-year Huntington's data readout, with the stock (~$44-48 in mid-to-late August, off its 52-week high of $71.50) still reflecting Strong Buy consensus (~$65-71 average PT) after Wolfe's late-July upgrade and Wells Fargo's $75 target. The regulatory picture has been de-risked since June's FDA reversal clearing an accelerated-approval path, and the $259M July capital raise (cash to 2030) removed near-term financing overhang, leaving the September data and the planned Q3 2026 BLA/MAA filings as the key swing factors for the stock into year-end.
